newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Dec crude steel output up 1.1 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Japan Dec crude steel output up 1.1 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Japan's crude steel output rose 1.1 percent in December from a year earlier to 8.42 million tonnes, the Japan Iron and Steel Federation said on Thursday.
The December figure was down 2.3 percent from November, the industry group said in a statement.
The nation's crude steel production in calendar 1996 fell 2.8 percent from the previous year to 98.80 million tonnes, the industry group said.
In 1995, Japan's crude steel output was 101.64 million tonnes, exceeding the crucial level of 100 million tonnes.
Crude steel output in 1994 was 98.29 million tonnes.
December output of tin plate was 123,700 tonnes, down 2.1 percent year-on-year and down 4.6 percent month-on-month, the federation said.
Output of tin plate in the whole of 1996 was 1.58 million tonnes, down 6.6 percent from the year before, it said.
Production of galvanised steel sheet in December was 976,200 tonnes, up 3.7 percent year-on-year and up 1.0 percent month-on-month.
Output of galvanised steel sheet in the whole of 1996 was 11.34 million tonnes, down 3.2 percent from the previous year, it said.
